title: Fabrication
description: Ultimate Fabric optimization modpack with Sodium and Iris. Also thoroughly tested on low-end laptops and Android devices for maximum FPS!
body:
![Fabrication Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fa410654f48579a532862de9ec00c9992a68b8e_0.webp)

> **The lightweight Fabric modpack built for performance, smooth gameplay and competitive multiplayer.** Fabrication is a carefully curated optimization modpack that combines the best Fabric performance, rendering and networking mods into one polished experience. Designed for players who want the highest FPS possible without sacrificing visuals or compatibility. --- ![ftrs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4cd12c8cac948a08bd58f055b6ea8d1b8ed7ff0.png) ✔ High FPS ✔ Reduced RAM Usage ✔ Faster Startup ✔ Reduced Stuttering ✔ Multiplayer Safe ✔ PvP Ready ✔ Beautiful Visuals ✔ Lightweight Design --- ![tstd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7021d29ece5de7c255a2f2f67971a449d8082d0c.png) Fabrication has been tested on multiple low-end devices, including laptops and Android tablets. Designed to provide: ⚡ Up to **100–250+ FPS** 🧠 Reduced RAM Usage 🚀 Faster Startup 🎮 Smooth Multiplayer Gameplay ✨ Beautiful Visuals *Performance depends on hardware, graphics settings and server conditions.* --- ![md](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d306e63d80fb0c74add07705de4cb39216ef3d3.png) ![performance_banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81494aa41fd65f44a5784cc7cdb12a267e7ffabd.png) • **Sodium** — Modern rendering engine for massive FPS improvements. • **Lithium** — Optimizes game physics and world logic. • **ImmediatelyFast** — Improves rendering, GUI and particle performance. • **ModernFix** — Faster startup, improved stability and reduced memory usage. • **FerriteCore** — Significantly lowers RAM usage. • **Memory Leak Fix** — Prevents memory leaks during long play sessions. • **Noisium** — Optimizes world generation and chunk loading. • **EntityCulling** — Skips rendering entities that aren't visible. • **More Culling** — Additional block and model culling optimizations. • **Cull Leaves** — Improves leaf rendering performance. • **Krypton** — Optimized networking for smoother multiplayer. • **ThreadTweak** — Better CPU thread scheduling for improved performance. • **Exordium** — Reduces GUI rendering overhead. • **Debugify** — Fixes dozens of vanilla Minecraft bugs. • **FastQuit** — Instantly leaves worlds and servers. --- ![pvp_banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53fda05108b5564da83ca9d2b24a69a628133fd3.png) • **Better Mount HUD** • **BetterF3** • **Mouse Tweaks** • **Shulker Box Tooltip** • **Fast IP Ping** • **Screenshot Gallery** • **Screenshot to Clipboard** --- ![visuals_banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a36b6f59c8d121ae448a5ad7bad4cd8182ab24b5.png) • **Iris** — Optimized shader support. • **Animatica Refabricated** — Restores animated textures from resource packs. • **OptiGUI** — Custom GUI textures for resource packs. • **Sodium Extra** — Additional graphics and performance options. • **Reese's Sodium Options** — Improved Sodium settings interface. • **Rival Visuals** *(Currently unavailable on Modrinth.)* --- ![why](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3da248e0e765ce9a8db35ddbadb5345479d64d1.png) ✔ Carefully selected mods ✔ Fully configured ✔ Lightweight ✔ Regularly updated ✔ Maximum compatibility ✔ No unnecessary bloat --- ![thx](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66a2c8b0746792b38fa8313daa52e1014193dba7.png) Huge thanks to every amazing Fabric developer. Fabrication wouldn't exist without the incredible open-source Minecraft community. ❤️
